description: The Honda N-WGN  is a kei car produced by Honda since 2013 over two generations. A Japanese market model, the N-WGN is a five-door hatchback with a front-mounted engine and either front-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. Together with the N-Box, N-One and N-Van, is part of the renewed N lineup of kei class city cars from Honda. The "N" prefix was previously used for the late 1960s and 1970s N360; originally it stood for norimono which loosely translates to vehicle. For the new N lineup, the "N" represented New, Next, Nippon, and Norimono.
